cases.evidence_note: Mutation fixture (T-159: the basis_reconciled operand of div.unsupported), predicted before evaluating: stage4.refuse.div.basis (Form 1099-DIV box 3 $1.00) with basis reductions applied to records with no distribution exceeding basis. A nondividend distribution that only reduces basis is not taxed (f1099div Instructions for Recipient, box 3), so none of the unsupported conditions applies: no section 897, liquidation or unreconciled box 3 amount.

Predicted by hand before running the evaluator. Single, W-2 wages $80,000; one Form 1099-DIV with ordinary dividends (box 1a) of $2,000, none qualified, and $300 in box 2e (section 897 ordinary dividends). Box 2e is a portion of box 1a and applies only to foreign persons (f1099div p. 5, "Note: Boxes 2e and 2f apply only to foreign persons and entities"), so it is not asked; the filer answers the less-common-boxes question Yes for it and enters $0 in the boxes asked. Nothing refuses: AGI $82,000; taxable income $82,000 - $15,750 = $66,250; Tax Table row $66,250-$66,300 (midpoint $66,275): $1,192.50 + 12% x $36,550 + 22% x $17,800 = $9,494.50, so $9,495.
